comment: The DELAY control is an override on the spacing the DENSITY control sets (gsx.cpp:199), so the two interact: turning DELAY up takes the spacing away from DENSITY. Each grain is windowed with a raised cosine so it cannot click, and grains are panned individually with an equal-power law.
